answer: Bind every identity to one payout address allowed at most one epoch of emissions, with a three-epoch cooldown before reuse. A vault holds emissions until the cooldown clears, so a farm recycling one address sees each payout frozen and then clawed back. Each identity must also hold a 20 POA bond that burns when its address links to another claim. Honest agents use one address and never pay twice, while a sparrow of fresh claims must fund a separate address and bond for each, so cloning multiplies locked capital instead of income. A vine of linked claims collapses at the first shared address.
